title: Image cache growth is bounded
summary:
Image generation got two practical guardrails: a bounded memory cache and quieter progress logs.

The generated-image cache limit dropped from 500,000 to 1,000 entries, with the oldest entry evicted when the limit is reached. That puts a ceiling on memory growth that could degrade image generation.

The image service no longer writes progress-bar updates to non-TTY logs, reducing log growth and the risk of disk exhaustion. Progress bars also use a default color when an ID is missing.
